bibliography.title: Manifold-Optimal Guidance: A Unified Riemannian Control View of Diffusion Guidance

sections.title: Supplementary B. Theoretical Derivation and Analysis
Supplementary E. User Study Details and Statistical Analysis
Supplementary H. Limitations and Future Work

abstract_sentences.text: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) serves as the de facto control mechanism for conditional diffusion, yet high guidance scales notoriously induce oversaturation, texture artifacts, and structural collapse.
We attribute this failure to a geometric mismatch: standard CFG performs Euclidean extrapolation in ambient space, inadvertently driving sampling trajectories off the high-density data manifold.
To resolve this, we present Manifold-Optimal Guidance (MOG), a framework that reformulates guidance as a local optimal control problem.
MOG yields a closed-form, geometry-aware Riemannian update that corrects off-manifold drift without requiring retraining.

Leveraging this perspective, we further introduce Auto-MOG, a dynamic energy-balancing schedule that adaptively calibrates guidance strength, effectively eliminating the need for manual hyperparameter tuning.
Extensive validation demonstrates that MOG yields superior fidelity and alignment compared to baselines, with virtually no added computational overhead.

claim_closure.claim: MOG-Score and Auto-MOG are training-free, efficient, and sampler-compatible.
claim_closure.method_response: Rank-one inverse and Algorithm 1 use quantities available during sampling and are claimed O(d).
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 2 reports 1.01×–1.08× latency for metric variants/Auto-MOG on the reported setup.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion says the closed form integrates into existing samplers without retraining.

claim_closure.claim: MOG improves fidelity and alignment across diverse architectures and benchmarks.
claim_closure.method_response: The same metric/update is presented as architecture-agnostic.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1 spans six model blocks and Figure 3 spans four user-study architectures; automated results have no seed-level uncertainty, and the prose/model-count relation is unclear.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion claims state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks.

claim_closure.claim: MOG suppresses off-manifold drift and high-scale artifacts.
claim_closure.method_response: Metric penalizes the score-normal direction and uses an energy-balanced scale.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figures 2, 6, and 7 plus saturation/contrast and preference metrics are compatible proxies; the paper does not report trajectory-to-manifold distance on real benchmarks.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion says MOG effectively suppresses off-manifold drift and high-scale artifacts.

claim_closure.claim: Auto-MOG removes the need for manual guidance tuning.
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (13)–(14) derives beta from prior and guidance energies.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figures 4–5, Table 4, and Table 10 compare steps, gamma, tuned CFG, and a linear schedule.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion recovers adaptive strength from a single objective.

limitations.name: explicit main-body limitations section
limitations.description: 主文 p. 1–10 没有 Limitations heading 或独立限制段；explicit self-limitation appears in supplementary H.

limitations.name: base-estimator dependence
limitations.description: If the unconditional score is poorly calibrated in sparse/OOD regions, the derived metric can impose an inaccurate geometry; MOG cannot repair fundamental base-vector-field pathologies.

limitations.name: rank-one codimension assumption
limitations.description: The rank-1 metric implicitly assumes a locally one-dimensional off-manifold direction and may miss components for high-codimension modalities.

evidence.anchor: might fail to penalize all components

limitations.name: static anisotropy heuristic
limitations.description: A global rho=10 is a simplification; optimal penalty is described as dynamic and spatially varying with local curvature.

limitations.name: numerical high-noise boundary
limitations.description: Small/high-variance s0 at t→T can destabilize metric construction; the supplement uses epsilon normalization and a beta clamp.

limitations.name: observed user-preference failure modes
limitations.description: Among rejected cases, the paper reports texture smoothing (~15%), stylistic oversaturation preference (~8%), and semantic layout shift (~5%).

final_judgment.single_storyline: 高 CFG scale 的失败被建模为 Euclidean guidance 与局部数据几何不匹配；MOG 用 metric-preconditioned conditional increment 取得局部 steepest descent，Auto-MOG 再以能量比自适应强度，实验将其包装为 fidelity、alignment 和 artifact 的同步改善。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留了问题定义、Figure 1 直觉、Eq. (5)–(14)、rank-one inverse、Algorithm 1、模型/指标/基线、Figure 2、Table 1、Figure 3 及核心 ablation。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Supplement 承担 exact-score derivation、Lagrange proof、数值 safeguard、sample count/超参数、user-study protocol/statistics/failure modes、extended ablation、additional qualitative grids 和 limitations。正文理解机制足够，审计统计与边界需读 supplement。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先以一个机制图压缩问题和反事实，再给能执行的目标函数与闭式更新，随后把 broad table、human preference 与 alternative-tuning ablation 排成同一因果链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: off-manifold drift 是解释轴，真实 benchmark 却没有 trajectory-to-manifold distance 或 metric-estimation error；同时 proof 对 exact scores 成立，而实现使用近似 neural scores。因此机制证据为部分闭合。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 机制型论文应让可直接接近机制的 observable 与任务指标并列，并在主文显示 exact-to-approximate bridge；再用 ablation 排除最接近的强度、组件或 baseline 替代解释。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 只有机制存在可测 proxy 且 proxy 与机制有明确对应时才适用；toy illustration、quality metric 或单次视觉网格不能单独承担机制验证。
